bastar-pine-project.conditions_add: The President's 1975 report to the Board said the credit would take effect only once a project manager acceptable to IDA had been appointed and a state committee to monitor the project and coordinate the feasibility and tribal studies had been set up (World Bank, Report and Recommendation of the President, Madhya Pradesh Forestry Technical Assistance Project, 1975). The draft agreements described in the same report also provided that India would take action acceptable to IDA to keep the state forest development corporation financially viable, and that Madhya Pradesh would set up a committee so that environmental effects of future forest projects were reviewed while still being planned (World Bank, 1975).

why.safeguard: Madhya Pradesh would set up a committee so that environmental effects of future forest projects were reviewed

shwe-taung-cement-thazi.conditions_add: IFC's action plan for the 2017 investment required Shwe Taung Cement to upgrade its environmental and safety management systems at the cement plant, quarries and coal mine, hire independent specialists to audit them, review other routes for the new coal-mine road to limit harm to wildlife and water, and route the new power line along the existing right of way where possible (IFC, Environmental and Social Review Summary, project 38831). Because the limestone quarry and coal mine areas are Critical Habitat under IFC's standards, the plan also required a Biodiversity Action Plan aiming at no net loss of natural habitat and a net gain for critical habitat, and screening of raw-material suppliers for child or forced labour and habitat clearing (IFC, ESRS 38831).

why.safeguard: required a Biodiversity Action Plan aiming at no net loss of natural habitat

The 1964 supplemental agreement directed the Fund's money first to the cost of goods for the dam on the Jhelum River, which is Mangla (Indus Basin Development Fund Supplemental Agreement, 1964).

lower-kihansi-dam.conditions_add: The 1993 Power VI credit, which paid for the Lower Kihansi plant, could only take effect after TANESCO's average electricity tariff was raised to US$0.09 per kWh, the government paid TANESCO's certified bills owed by government agencies, and a subsidiary loan agreement and project manager were in place (World Bank, Report and Recommendation of the President, Power VI Project, 1993). In negotiations the government agreed to offer TANESCO's line-construction business for sale to private investors by the end of 1993 and to hire consultants to study privatization options, and TANESCO agreed to raise tariffs 3.5 percent a year until a tariff study was carried out; TANESCO also agreed to keep a hiring freeze until a staffing study was carried out and to carry out an environmental mitigation plan for Lower Kihansi acceptable to IDA by June 1994 (World Bank, 1993).

why.priv: offer TANESCO's line-construction business for sale to private investors
why.safeguard: carry out an environmental mitigation plan for Lower Kihansi acceptable to IDA

The Bank could suspend the loan if the decree setting up the waste agency ANGed was changed in a way that harmed its ability to meet its duties (World Bank, Loan Agreement, 2007).

bolivia-eastern-lowlands-soy.conditions_add: Among the main agreements for the 1990 credit, Bolivia agreed to send Congress a law by 31 December 1990 requiring public land to be sold at market prices (except to indigenous communities and small farmers) and to charge market prices by end-1991, to adopt rules enforcing a Land Use Plan acceptable to IDA by end-1991, and to give no official credit for land clearing unless approved under that plan or soil studies (World Bank, Report and Recommendation of the President, 1990). Before the credit line could pay out, soil studies and the first region-wide forest cover survey had to be finished (World Bank, 1990).

dakar-diamniadio-toll-highway.conditions_add: Before the 2009 IDA credit could take effect, Senegal had to pay or set aside FCFA 8 billion and FCFA 15.7 billion in separate accounts for compensating displaced people, sign a contract with a private operator to run a replacement landfill, and have the concession agreement with the private highway company signed with its financing in place (World Bank, Project Appraisal Document, 2009). Covenants required the Mbeubeuss landfill to close by 30 November 2010, barred moving displaced people to the resettlement site until that landfill was closed and the site was working, and required the Bank's written confirmation that safeguard documents had been fully complied with before Phase 3 and Phase 4 works began (World Bank, PAD, 2009). IFC's 2010 review based its resettlement assessment on the World Bank-approved resettlement documents and did not require the concession company to prepare a separate one (IFC, Environmental and Social Review Summary, project 29008).

why.safeguard: required the Bank's written confirmation that safeguard documents had been fully complied with
why.priv: sign a contract with a private operator to run a replacement landfill

lom-pangar-dam.conditions_add: Before the 2012 IDA credit could take effect, Cameroon had to adopt water tariff legislation for hydropower operators in the Sanaga River basin that would pay, among other things, the running costs of Deng Deng National Park, and IDA had to be satisfied the country was complying with the safeguard documents (World Bank, Project Appraisal Document, 2012). Covenants required a dam safety panel and an independent environmental and social panel, an independent auditor of safeguards within four months, and a local development contract before money for local micro-projects could be paid (World Bank, PAD, 2012). The EIB finance contract required the borrower to make the project company meet its environmental and social management plans and action plan, and to get the EIB's approval before changing the management plans or the resettlement plan (EIB Complaints Mechanism, Conclusions Report, 2024).

why.fees: adopt water tariff legislation for hydropower operators in the Sanaga River basin
why.safeguard: IDA had to be satisfied the country was complying with the safeguard documents
